scope: Implement the accepted 60-fit plan on the original RTX4060 after qualification and engineering trials; no extra arms, backbone or cohort

training.sampler: Existing SCC-only weighted replacement sampler, inner-training counts only
training.selection: First strict maximum of inner-validation BACC
training.randomness: Reset the paired seed after model initialization; preserve original seeded sampler

encodings.constant_metadata_optional: [0,0,0,0,1] in every phase; full DSMAF graph retained

reference_rg.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; retain attribution and do not relicense the reference as MIT
reference_rg.status: Candidate adaptation; synthetic fusion-only probe passed; full visual adapter not implemented or tested
reference_rg.caveat: Single-token attention weights are identically one. Retain and disclose the released numerical-metadata behavior. No silent tokenization changes. Author page labels paper preprint, proceedings citation pending.

inference.internal: One held-out prediction per image per seed; pooled OOF over frozen five outer folds
inference.external: Original 1701 cases, exact original ordering/exclusions; evaluate all five fold models; aggregate per-class recalls with original fixed fold support weights; no probability ensemble
inference.evaluation_release: Freeze all chosen new fits and checkpoint inventories before any new outer/external outcome access

primary_information_contrasts: D-C: existing full DSMAF minus age_recorded
statistics.secondary_information_contrast: B-A: age_only DSMAF minus existing image_only; whole-model difference with architecture confounding, not isolated age effect
statistics.optional_age_contrast: B-A0 only if the 15 constant-metadata full-architecture controls are selected before training
baseline_comparisons: Each new method minus existing image_only
Each new method minus existing late_fusion
Each new method minus existing full DSMAF
metrics: BACC in percent; differences in percentage points
statistics.bootstrap_scope: Independent patient-cluster sampling within each cohort, shared draws across arms and seeds; fixed models and fixed external fold weights. Percentile 95% descriptive unadjusted intervals. No model-fit resampling.
statistics.seed_summary: Show all three paired seed deltas, mean and sample SD; never label as five-seed results
prohibited_claims: Causal effect of recording or biological sex
State-of-the-art superiority from adapted five-feature baselines
Isolated fusion-mechanism effect where visual representations and heads differ
General validity across training recipes from a single chosen recipe

preflight_requirements: New adapters and evaluation collector must be implemented and checked before training
Verify original ImageNet V2 initialization on GPU worker
Use matching worker environment or declare and assess changes
Complete full-backbone synthetic forward/loss checks and memory/timing benchmark without external-outcome tuning
Select 60-fit or optional 75-fit scope before training
failure_policy: Document all failed attempts. Restart a failed fit from its fixed seed only for technical reasons, retaining logs. If protocol changes affect comparability, version the plan before outcomes; do not selectively rerun poor results or add seeds based on significance.
public_release_policy: No new case-level public release is authorized by this plan. Existing code-publication task and data-disclosure decision remain separate.
implementation_status: Complete worker orchestration prepared; CPU validation and archive qualification pending final run
hypothesis_policy: Method changes must be justified against related work and selected with internal development data only. No stronger claims before new results.
readiness_policy: No GPU result is assumed. The worker must qualify all models and pass four one-epoch trials before the fixed formal matrix can start.
working_data_policy: Local handoff to the original RTX4060 only; no public patient-level upload and no journal submission by this pipeline.
